filename: Background Pycnocline Depth Constrains Future Ocean Heat Uptake Efficiency.pdf
title: Background Pycnocline Depth Constrains Future Ocean Heat Uptake Efficiency
code_availability: The figure-making code uses Matplotlib version 3.5.2 (Caswell et al., 2022) and is publicly available in the Zenodo repository (Newsom, 2023) at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.8357059.
testbed_rationale: This study analyzes diagnostic physical relationships between stratification and heat uptake across CMIP and MITgcm simulations without introducing high-resolution benchmark datasets for ML parameterization.
pain_points: Two-fold spread in Ocean Heat Uptake Efficiency (OHUE) across contemporary climate models
Substantial sensitivity of stratification and ocean heat uptake to parameterized eddy diffusivity (kappa_GM) and vertical mixing (kappa_nu) in coarse-resolution models
extraction_notes: No machine learning models were developed or evaluated; data-driven closures are mentioned in the discussion as a prospective motivation.
